scope: The four-front former Treasury Building as it stood in 2005, with the sandstone street walls, corner pavilions and covered central courtyard from the 1990s adaptation. The separate former Land Administration Building, its hotel, and interiors are outside this model.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Brisbane City Council identifies the registered Treasury Building at 21 Queen Street.
The 2017 conservation plan establishes all four street elevations, the building phases, original masonry, roof sheet cladding and roof lanterns, and the 1990s covering of the courtyard.
